prompts.name: autumn
prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Landscape 16:9 concept background for the opening of a tiny rustic pixel-art game, Cheese Town. Authentic coarse 160x90 logical pixel art enlarged nearest-neighbor, crisp rectangular pixel clusters, limited palette of cocoa brown, burnt orange, ochre, muted moss and desaturated blue, subdued lighting. Atmospheric and symbolic, NOT a detailed story illustration or specific game map. Very quiet dark open middle 60 percent reserved for centered cream text added by the game. No actual text, lettering, UI, characters, faces, intricate buildings, borders, photorealism, smooth gradients, or painterly textures. Suggest autumn and approaching winter: sparse angular ochre leaves on the outer corners, layered distant moss hills and silhouettes of tree trunks at the extreme edges, large still dusk-blue sky and subdued ochre haze in the center. Warm but slightly uneasy.
